name: MOSFET switching circuit
description: MOSFET used as on/off switch. Gate drive level determines RDS_on; load is in drain (high-side) or source (low-side).
expected_signal_behavior: When on: VDS ~ 0 (RDS_on * I); when off: VDS = supply. Gate drive must exceed VGS_th with margin.

common_failure_modes.description: gate drive high, FET shorted D-S
inductive load kicks back, FET avalanches

recommended_next_tests: check gate drive level vs VGS_th
check flyback diode for inductive loads
